title: MECT: Mixture of Experts with CNN-Transformer Network for Speaker verification
abstract: arXiv:2609.24061v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In this paper, we propose MECT, a speaker verification model that integrates the Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) mechanism into a CNN-Transformer backbone with optimized block structure and stacking scheme. Specifically, we investigated four MoE variants that span utterance-level and frame-level granularity with dense and sparse routing strategies. The MoE mechanism proves to be effective over the baseline without MoE with only a small increase in parameters. We further scale MECT to a series of model sizes, all maintaining compact parameters and low computational complexity. In particular, MECT-B2 achieves state-of-the-art performance on VoxCeleb1 and delivers strong results on CN-Celeb, demonstrating its effectiveness across diverse datasets. In addition, we establish a streaming inference paradigm through causal retraining, which maintains strong performance at a chunk size of 100ms.

translated_title: MECT：基于CNN-Transformer网络的专家混合说话人验证模型
translated_abstract: 在这篇论文中，我们提出了MECT，这是一种将专家混合机制集成到CNN-Transformer骨干网络中的说话人验证模型，并采用了优化的块结构和堆叠方案。具体而言，我们研究了四种MoE变体，涵盖话语级和帧级粒度，并采用密集和稀疏路由策略。结果表明，MoE机制在参数仅少量增加的情况下，比不含MoE的基线模型更加有效。我们进一步将MECT扩展到一系列不同规模的模型，所有模型均保持紧凑的参数量和较低的计算复杂度。特别地，MECT-B2在VoxCeleb1数据集上实现了最先进的性能，并在CN-Celeb上取得了强劲的结果，证明了其在不同数据集上的有效性。此外，我们通过因果重训练建立了流式推理范式，在100ms的块大小下仍能保持强大的性能。
tldr: 提出MECT说话人验证模型，将专家混合机制集成到CNN-Transformer骨干网络中，在VoxCeleb1上达到最先进性能，并通过因果重训练实现了100ms块大小的流式推理。
en_tdlr: Proposes MECT, a speaker verification model integrating Mixture-of-Experts into a CNN-Transformer backbone, achieving state-of-the-art performance on VoxCeleb1 and enabling streaming inference with 100ms chunks through causal retraining.
